sequence: Freeze and replay the G9 precursor formation after G8 rejection and unrevealed-secret destruction.
A fresh independent custodian seals a new encrypted holdout and receipt. Loss of its private custody before reveal terminates G9; it never weakens the gate.

Freeze one reviewed-subject.json binding the exact formation, precursor closure, holdout receipt/ciphertext, and predetermined custodian/challenge/root task identities. It contains no challenge or root hashes.
Two independent challenges bind the exact reviewed-subject hash. Neither sees peer work or hidden material.
Root binds the same subject and the exact two challenge bytes, and unions their blockers.
Only a later admission-envelope.json adds the exact subject, challenge, and root identities. The validator fully checks every content and identity join before emitting AUTHORS_MAY_BEGIN.
Four isolated authors receive common contract/harness inputs plus exactly one H/B/S/D lineage packet. No candidate source exists before admission.
Holdout reveal, candidate correctness, benchmarks, five skeptics, three adjudicators, exact-hash selection, and prototype integration are later gates over real candidate bytes.
explicit_limits: Content hashes prove bundle identity, not a model's identity; the Codex task receipts are the external actor-provenance witness.
Pre-reveal public validation cannot prove hidden-case semantic adequacy; the ciphertext commitment prevents later substitution and the five skeptics judge the revealed corpus.
A live private custodian store is intentionally fail-closed rather than falsely durable: task loss rejects the generation and strands no accepted candidate.
